label: Fan-in capacity
subgoals: Divide each die side by the ball pitch
Floor and multiply to get the ball count
Compare with the I/O the die needs

label: Fan-out area expansion
subgoals: Round the square root of the ball count up
Multiply by the pitch for the package side
Divide package area by die area

label: Reconstituted wafers and panels
subgoals: Add the saw street to the package size
Count units along each panel side and multiply
Name die shift and warpage as the process limits
